landing.hero_desc: Medivio connects patients and doctors through artificial intelligence. Consult, track your vitals and receive prescriptions from anywhere.
landing.features_subtitle: A complete platform for patients and doctors
landing.doctor_desc: Join Medivio and manage your consultations, prescriptions and patients from a single platform.
landing.feature_video_desc: Consult your doctor by video from home.
landing.feature_async_desc: Send your symptoms and medical documents, a doctor responds within 24h without an appointment.
landing.feature_prescription_desc: Receive your prescriptions with a QR code scannable at the pharmacy.
landing.feature_chronic_desc: Track your vital signs with automatic alerts.
landing.feature_senior_desc: Simplified interface with voice recognition for seniors.
landing.why_ai_desc: AI analyzes your patients symptoms and automatically drafts your consultation reports.
landing.why_senior_desc: Simplified voice interface for seniors, accessible to all from the first use.
landing.why_commission_desc: You keep 100% of your fees. No hidden charges.
landing.why_allinone_desc: Agenda, prescriptions, billing and video in one application. Zero paperwork.
landing.why_doctor_data_desc: Secure, encrypted patient records compliant with GDPR. Your consultations remain private.
landing.why_patient_data_desc: Secure, encrypted medical record compliant with GDPR. No one else has access.
landing.why_triage_desc: AI evaluates your symptoms and tells you exactly when and how to see a doctor.
landing.why_home_desc: No need to travel. Access a doctor by video wherever you are, whenever you need.

triage_page.hero_desc: Before even consulting a doctor, Medivio clinically evaluates your symptoms using artificial intelligence.
triage_page.chat_bot_1: Hello! Describe your symptoms and I will evaluate your health.
triage_page.chat_patient: I have had a fever for 2 days, headaches and intense fatigue.
triage_page.chat_bot_2: Based on your clinical evaluation, rapid medical care is recommended. Would you like to be connected to an available doctor?
triage_page.step1_desc: Answer a few simple questions about your symptoms, their duration and intensity.
triage_page.step2_desc: Our medical algorithm evaluates your clinical condition in real time and identifies warning signs.
triage_page.step3_desc: You immediately receive an urgency level and a personalized medical recommendation.
triage_page.section2_desc: A complete clinical analysis in seconds, accessible from any device.
triage_page.card1_desc: Precise assessment of the urgency of your medical situation: standard, urgent or critical.
triage_page.card2_desc: Personalized medical recommendations adapted to your health condition and history.
triage_page.card3_desc: Guidance towards the specialist or medical resource best suited to your clinical situation.
triage_page.benefit1: Avoid costly medical misdirection in time and health
triage_page.benefit2: Consult at the right time, with the right practitioner, for optimal care
triage_page.benefit3: Access an initial clinical evaluation at any time, even outside opening hours
triage_page.benefit4: Reduce anxiety related to uncertainty with an objective and immediate medical analysis
triage_page.cta_title: Ready to take care of your health?
triage_page.cta_desc: Access AI Triage for free and get a clinical evaluation in seconds.

teleconsult_page.hero_desc: No more waiting room. Access medical video consultation wherever you are, whenever you need it.
teleconsult_page.section1_title: A consultation equivalent to an in-person visit
teleconsult_page.feature1_desc: HD video clinical exchange for a consultation equivalent in quality to an in-person visit.
teleconsult_page.feature2_desc: After the consultation, the practitioner can issue a digital prescription directly to your patient space.
teleconsult_page.feature3_desc: The doctor accesses your medical history during the consultation for optimal care.
teleconsult_page.section2_desc: Consult from home, work or while traveling, at the time that suits you.
teleconsult_page.card1_desc: No need to travel. Consult comfortably from home, without geographical constraints.
teleconsult_page.card2_title: At the time that suits you
teleconsult_page.card2_desc: Slots available early morning, evening and weekends to fit your schedule.
teleconsult_page.card3_desc: Compatible with smartphone, tablet and computer. No installation required, direct access from your browser.
teleconsult_page.benefit1: End-to-end encrypted video connection — no data is accessible to third parties
teleconsult_page.benefit2: Medical data hosted on secure servers, compliant with GDPR and French health standards
teleconsult_page.benefit3: Consultation protected by two-factor authentication to guarantee your identity
teleconsult_page.benefit4: No recording of the consultation without explicit consent from the patient and practitioner
teleconsult_page.cta_desc: Book an appointment in a few clicks and consult from home today.

ordonnance_page.hero_desc: Receive your digital prescriptions instantly after your consultation and present them at the pharmacy via a secure QR code.
ordonnance_page.section1_title: How does the digital prescription work?
ordonnance_page.step1_desc: After the consultation, the doctor writes and electronically signs your prescription directly on the platform.
ordonnance_page.step2_desc: The prescription appears immediately in your patient space, accessible from any device.
ordonnance_page.step3_desc: Simply show the QR code to the pharmacist. They verify authenticity in one scan and dispense your medication.
ordonnance_page.section2_desc: Access all your past prescriptions from your patient record at any time.
ordonnance_page.card1_desc: Find all your past prescriptions sorted by date, practitioner or prescribed medication.
ordonnance_page.card2_desc: Download your prescriptions as PDF to keep them or share with another health professional.
ordonnance_page.card3_desc: Receive a notification before your prescriptions expire so you never miss a renewal.
ordonnance_page.benefit1: Your prescriptions are stored securely and accessible for life from your patient space
ordonnance_page.benefit2: The QR code is unique and unfalsifiable — your pharmacist can verify its authenticity instantly
ordonnance_page.benefit3: Easily share your prescription with a relative or another health professional
ordonnance_page.benefit4: Compatible with all pharmacies equipped with a QR code reader
ordonnance_page.cta_desc: Create your patient space for free and access your digital prescriptions at any time.

chronic_page.hero_desc: Record your biological and clinical parameters and receive automatic alerts when an anomaly is detected.
chronic_page.all_normal: All your parameters are within normal range
chronic_page.vital1_desc: Systolic and diastolic — monitoring cardiovascular risks
chronic_page.vital2_desc: Heart rate at rest and during activity
chronic_page.vital3_desc: Blood glucose level — essential for diabetic patients
chronic_page.vital4_desc: Body mass index tracking and weight evolution monitoring
chronic_page.vital5_desc: Early detection of infectious or inflammatory syndromes
chronic_page.section2_desc: AI analyzes your data in real time and notifies you immediately when an abnormal value is detected.
chronic_page.level1_desc: Your parameters are within normal range. Continue your regular monitoring as recommended by your doctor.
chronic_page.level2_desc: A value is slightly outside normal range. A medical consultation is advised in the coming days.
chronic_page.level3_desc: A vital parameter is abnormal. Urgent medical care is recommended. Your doctor has been alerted.
chronic_page.benefit1: Your practitioner accesses your monitoring data in real time for optimal medical follow-up
chronic_page.benefit2: Critical alerts are automatically sent to your referring doctor for maximum responsiveness
chronic_page.benefit3: Share your monitoring history with any specialist in one click
chronic_page.benefit4: Each consultation automatically integrates your latest measurements for informed care
chronic_page.cta_desc: Start your chronic monitoring for free and benefit from intelligent clinical alerts in real time.

async_page.hero_desc: Submit your symptoms and medical documents. A qualified doctor reviews your file and responds as soon as possible.
async_page.case_desc: Recurring abdominal pain for 3 weeks, accompanied by morning nausea. History of chronic gastritis.
async_page.doctor_response: Given your medical history and the results submitted, I recommend an upper gastrointestinal endoscopy. I am sending you a prescription...
async_page.step1_desc: Write your reason for consultation, describe your symptoms and their evolution, and specify your medical history.
async_page.step2_desc: Upload your biological tests, imaging reports or previous prescriptions to facilitate the review of your file.
async_page.step3_desc: A qualified doctor reviews your clinical file and sends you a detailed report accompanied, if necessary, by a prescription.
async_page.section2_desc: Async consultation is suitable for non-urgent medical situations requiring a qualified opinion.
async_page.card1_desc: Get a qualified second medical opinion on a diagnosis or treatment prescribed by another practitioner.
async_page.card2_desc: Renew your chronic treatment prescriptions without traveling, subject to doctor's approval.
async_page.card3_desc: Have your biological tests or imaging examinations interpreted by a specialist doctor.
async_page.benefit1: Your file is reviewed by a qualified doctor registered with the Medical Council
async_page.benefit2: You receive a detailed medical report accompanied, if necessary, by a digital prescription
async_page.benefit3: If an urgent situation is detected, you are immediately redirected to appropriate medical care
async_page.benefit4: All your medical data is encrypted and hosted on HDS-certified servers
async_page.cta_desc: Submit your medical file and receive a qualified response within 24h.

pricing_page.included_desc: Pilot doctors access the full Medivio platform for 3 months.
pricing_page.f1_desc: Automatic analysis of your patients' symptoms before the consultation
pricing_page.f2_desc: HD video consultations, secured and end-to-end encrypted
pricing_page.f3_desc: Generate and sign your digital prescriptions with pharmacy QR code
pricing_page.f4_desc: Access your patients' clinical monitoring data in real time
pricing_page.f5_desc: Respond to your patients' medical files within 24h
pricing_page.f6_desc: Manage your schedule, consultations and billing
pricing_page.after_desc: After the 3 free months, offers adapted to your practice will be proposed. Pricing will be defined in collaboration with pilot doctors.
pricing_page.after_note: * Final pricing will be communicated at the end of the pilot phase. No commitment during the 3 free months.

pricing_page.b2b_desc: Medivio offers tailor-made solutions for organizations wishing to integrate telemedicine into their services. Contact us to discuss your project.
pricing_page.cta_desc: 3 months free, full access, no commitment. Be among the first to transform your medical practice.
